programs.desc: The Bahamas is a dream place to spend your vacation.The program's heroes, with the help of local agents, set out to look for a house in this paradise scenery.Together they choose an island and a property.

programs.title: Baggage Battles 3
programs.desc: Every year, passengers traveling around the world lose millions of pieces of luggage.Many of them do not come forward to collect their lost items.Smart Billy Leroy, self-confident Mark Meyer and eccentric husband and wife Laurence and Sally Martin turned lost suitcases into a source of profit.Each of them visits auctions where unclaimed goods, items seized by the police or left at airports are auctioned.Relying on experience and intuition, they try to gain possession of the treasures hidden in the bags.It turns out that they can earn thousands of dollars in this not very complicated way.

programs.title: Unobvious places
programs.desc: Łukasz and Piotr had been looking for a house to buy for almost two years.Finally, the building of the old school in Kwieciszowice, near Jelenia Góra, stole their hearts.Patryk, who lived in Tricity for many years, finally settled in Borzęcin, near Słupsk.He was also enchanted by the building of the former German school.Anna and Paweł came across a ruined school during a bicycle trip around Masuria Garbate.They immediately knew that this place had huge potential.The building's appearance today is confirmation of this.
